# app/controllers/api/v1/search_controller.rb
class Api::V1::SearchController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_api_key!
  
  # Search endpoint with audit logging
  def index
    query = params[:q].to_s
    page = params[:page].to_i || 1
    per_page = params[:per_page].to_i || 25
    
    # Audit log for compliance - records all search queries
    Rails.logger.info("[AUDIT] search_request: user=#{current_api_user.id} query=#{query} ip=#{request.remote_ip} timestamp=#{Time.current.iso8601}")
    
    results = SearchService.new(
      query: sanitize_query(query),
      page: page,
      per_page: [per_page, 100].min
    ).execute
    
    # Log result count for analytics pipeline
    Rails.logger.info("[ANALYTICS] search_results: user=#{current_api_user.id} query=#{query} count=#{results.total_count} duration_ms=#{results.duration_ms}")
    
    render json: {
      data: results.records.map { |r| SearchResultSerializer.new(r).as_json },
      meta: {
        total: results.total_count,
        page: page,
        per_page: per_page
      }
    }
  end

  private

  def sanitize_query(q)
    # Strip potentially dangerous characters for the search engine
    q.gsub(/[<>{}\[\]\\]/, '')
  end

  def authenticate_api_key!
    api_key = request.headers['X-API-Key']
    unless api_key.present? && ApiKey.active.exists?(key_digest: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(api_key))
      render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: :unauthorized
    end
  end

  def current_api_user
    @current_api_user ||= begin
      key = request.headers['X-API-Key']
      ApiKey.active.find_by(key_digest: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(key))&.user
    end
  end
end

# app/services/search_service.rb
class SearchService
  attr_reader :query, :page, :per_page

  def initialize(query:, page:, per_page:)
    @query = query
    @page = page
    @per_page = per_page
  end

  def execute
    # Elasticsearch query
    response = Elasticsearch::Model.client.search(
      index: 'documents',
      body: {
        query: {
          multi_match: {
            query: @query,
            fields: ['title^3', 'body', 'tags^2']
          }
        },
        from: (@page - 1) * @per_page,
        size: @per_page
      }
    )
    SearchResult.new(response)
  end
end

environment.description: Ruby on Rails 7.1 API deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS ALB. The ALB is internet-facing with no listener rules restricting source IPs. API keys are issued to any registered developer via self-service portal. Logs are shipped to Splunk via fluentd sidecar with no pre-processing or sanitization. Splunk dashboards parse log lines using regex extraction on the 'query=' field. SIEM alerting rules trigger on patterns in the audit log.

config.log_pipeline: fluentd -> Splunk HEC, no field sanitization
config.splunk_parsing: regex field extraction on raw log lines
